result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the fixed bottom navigation obscures the restaurant card beneath it.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel’s third restaurant card is cut off by the right viewport edge, including its image, name, and delivery text. The text is hard-clipped rather than cleanly truncated.
issues.suggestion: Constrain carousel items to the available width or add intentional horizontal-scroll spacing. Apply ellipsis to text within each card so labels do not clip at the viewport edge.

issues.description: A category pill is almost entirely off-screen on the right, leaving only an unlabeled gray sliver visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip widths and spacing to show a meaningful portion of the next item, or hide fully off-screen chips until the row is scrolled.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the lower restaurant card, hiding part of its image and controls.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation bar and safe-area height so all cards can scroll fully above the fixed navigation.
